summary: Production sign-in broken: account.issuer is NOT NULL but better-auth 1.7.4 never writes it
evidence: Better Auth startup schema check: 'Required columns Better Auth never writes: account.issuer. Inserts into account will fail.' Root cause: commit 5a4317d bumped better-auth 1.7.1 -> 1.7.4; 1.7.3 reverted the issuer-scoped account key. node_modules better-auth 1.7.4 internal-adapter.mjs:671 findAccountByKey({providerId, accountId}) - issuer gone - so the plugin's findAccountByKey({issuer, accountId}) also matched nothing, breaking existing-user sign-in, not only new signups.

summary: households.db.test.ts gated only on Boolean(process.env.DATABASE_URL), so a set-but-unreachable database failed the suite instead of skipping it
evidence: With postgres stopped and DATABASE_URL loaded from .env: 12 of 13 db suites printed 'SKIPPING … no reachable migrated database' and households.db.test.ts failed with 'Error: connect ECONNREFUSED ::1:55432' from its beforeAll. Its 12 siblings all probe with a bounded 'select 1 from <table> limit 0'. Latent before this change only because nothing set DATABASE_URL for a plain 'pnpm test'.
